verified_capabilities.finding: All observations use current or trailing bars only; rolling warm-up is preserved and zero denominators are handled without introducing future data.

Every run uses a chronological split and fits StandardScaler on training rows only. Adjacent-cutoff diagnostics preserve train_fraction=0.80, not one fixed absolute train/OOS boundary; each truncated sample recalculates its boundary.
Independent seed groups, bounded deterministic restart schedules, convergence checks, selected seeds, and all successful/failed attempts are retained.
Posteriors are calculated with a normalized log-space forward filter rather than smoothed future-aware state inference.
Same-K fits are aligned by Gaussian-emission characteristics before comparison; characterization preserves train/OOS contradictions and event coverage.
K=3-8 and exactly three feature sets are compared with explicit worst-seed guardrails and machine-readable decisions; likelihood alone cannot select a model.

Adjacent-cutoff and expanded-restart diagnostics preserve the fixed features, K, train_fraction=0.80, seeds, restart schedules, guardrails, and rare-state threshold. The absolute split boundary changes with each truncated sample.

The formal restart-promotion decision has a hash-verified historical audit trail. Exact reproduction is possible only while the retained artifact or another identical recovered copy exists; the checksum cannot reconstruct the file after expiry.

A fixed SPY 1D profile, Pine forward filter, comparator, and checkpoint fixture exist. Probability normalization and dominant-state agreement are verified; the formal cross-platform result remains feed mismatch.

known_limitations: The five-feature SPY 1D K=8 candidate is cutoff-sensitive after expanded restarts: 4 of 5 frozen adjacent cutoffs pass and the 2026-07-21 cutoff has 1.9680% minimum OOS occupancy below the unchanged 2% guardrail.
The expanded [0..8] restart schedule was not promoted; the shared research schedule remains [0,1,2].
No final production K or production model profile has been selected. The committed spy-1d-v0.1 K=3 profile is a Pine parity reference only.
Small historical adjusted-OHLC revisions can change the selected local optimum and guardrail outcome, demonstrating data-revision and non-stationarity sensitivity.

The Run #58 frozen OHLC is not durably stored in the repository. Exact reproduction is possible only while artifact 8590548073 remains available or an identical recovered copy exists; the checksum verifies but cannot reconstruct the file.
Yahoo-adjusted Python inputs and TradingView dividend-adjusted OHLC differ; identical-input Python-to-Pine inference parity has not been established.
The evidence is primarily SPY 1D research plus TLT method-validation workflow coverage; trading utility, walk-forward profitability, and cross-asset generalization remain untested.
Issue #24 productization remains a bounded prototype and does not represent production-model approval.
